-------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m2p1t3 --------------------------
(* Container-ship crane yard: a coordinator drives a two-phase commit    *)
(* across berth participants to replicate one update to a shared record. *)
(* Twist: a participant may be slow (learn/apply late) but never fails.  *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Part == {1, 2, 3}

VARIABLES ctrlState, vote, decision, ack, record

vars == <<ctrlState, vote, decision, ack, record>>

Ballots == {"none", "yes", "no"}
Verdicts == {"none", "commit", "abort"}

Init ==
    /\ ctrlState = "idle"
    /\ vote = [p \in Part |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ ack = [p \in Part |-> "none"]
    /\ record = [p \in Part |-> 0]

\* Coordinator opens the ballot window.
StartVote ==
    /\ ctrlState = "idle"
    /\ ctrlState' = "collecting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, ack, record>>

\* A participant casts its ballot (slow ones cast later).
Cast(p) ==
    /\ ctrlState = "collecting"
    /\ vote[p] = "none"
    /\ \E b \in {"yes", "no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrlState, decision, ack, record>>

\* Unanimous yes -> commit.
CommitDecide ==
    /\ ctrlState = "collecting"
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \A p \in Part : vote[p] = "yes"
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ ctrlState' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, ack, record>>

\* Any no -> abort.
AbortDecide ==
    /\ ctrlState = "collecting"
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \E p \in Part : vote[p] = "no"
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ ctrlState' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, ack, record>>

\* A participant learns the decision (may be slow).
Learn(p) ==
    /\ decision # "none"
    /\ ack[p] = "none"
    /\ ack' = [ack EXCEPT ![p] = decision]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrlState, vote, decision, record>>

\* A participant that learned commit installs the update into its copy.
Apply(p) ==
    /\ ack[p] = "commit"
    /\ record[p] = 0
    /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![p] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrlState, vote, decision, ack>>

Done ==
    /\ decision # "none"
    /\ \A p \in Part : ack[p] = decision
    /\ \A p \in Part : (decision = "abort") \/ (record[p] = 1)

Next ==
    \/ StartVote
    \/ \E p \in Part : Cast(p)
    \/ CommitDecide
    \/ AbortDecide
    \/ \E p \in Part : Learn(p)
    \/ \E p \in Part : Apply(p)
    \/ (Done /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost update: a copy is installed only under a committed decision.
NoLostUpdate == \A p \in Part : record[p] = 1 => ack[p] = "commit"
=============================================================================
nl: In a container-ship crane yard a coordinator replicates a single update to a shared record across three berth participants using two-phase commit. The coordinator opens the ballot window with StartVote, and each participant casts a yes or no ballot with Cast; a participant may be slow to vote but never crashes. When every ballot is yes the coordinator issues CommitDecide, and if any ballot is no it issues AbortDecide. Each participant later runs Learn to pick up the recorded decision, again possibly slowly, and a participant that learned a commit runs Apply to install the update into its local copy. A guarded terminal step lets the system idle once the decision is fully propagated. The full action set is StartVote, Cast, CommitDecide, AbortDecide, Learn, and Apply. SAFETY PROPERTY: A participant's local copy shows the installed update only if that participant learned a commit decision.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m1p2t4 --------------------------
(* Car-wash conveyor line arranged as a ring of stations. A single token *)
(* grants the right to move soap units forward via a shuttle arm. Units  *)
(* are conserved: nothing is created or destroyed as they circulate.     *)
(* Twist: station capacities are reconfigured at runtime.                 *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Station == {1, 2, 3}
Units == 3        \* total conserved soap units in the loop
MaxCap == 4

Nxt(n) == (n % 3) + 1

VARIABLES token, load, cap, arm

vars == <<token, load, cap, arm>>

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ load = [n \in Station |-> IF n = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0]
    /\ cap = [n \in Station |-> 3]
    /\ arm = 0

\* Advance the ring token to the next station.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Nxt(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, arm>>

\* Token holder lifts one unit onto the empty shuttle arm.
Lift ==
    /\ arm = 0
    /\ load[token] > 0
    /\ arm' = 1
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![token] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, cap>>

\* Token holder deposits the carried unit at the next station.
Drop ==
    /\ arm = 1
    /\ load[Nxt(token)] < cap[Nxt(token)]
    /\ arm' = 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![Nxt(token)] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, cap>>

\* Runtime reconfiguration: widen a station.
RaiseCap(n) ==
    /\ cap[n] < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, load, arm>>

\* Runtime reconfiguration: narrow a station (never below its current load).
LowerCap(n) ==
    /\ cap[n] > load[n]
    /\ cap[n] > 1
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![n] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, load, arm>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ Lift
    \/ Drop
    \/ \E n \in Station : RaiseCap(n)
    \/ \E n \in Station : LowerCap(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: the soap units on stations plus the arm stay constant.
Conserved == load[1] + load[2] + load[3] + arm = Units
=============================================================================
nl: A car-wash conveyor line is arranged as a ring of three stations that circulate a fixed amount of soap. A single ring token, advanced by PassToken, grants its holder the sole right to move soap. The token holder runs Lift to raise one soap unit off its station onto the shuttle arm, and Drop to deposit the carried unit at the next station provided that station is below its capacity. Station capacities are reconfigured at runtime: RaiseCap widens a station and LowerCap narrows one but never below its current load. Because Lift and Drop only relocate soap and the capacity actions leave soap untouched, the total quantity in circulation is invariant. The full action set is PassToken, Lift, Drop, RaiseCap, and LowerCap. SAFETY PROPERTY: The soap units resting on the three stations plus the unit on the shuttle arm always sum to the fixed total.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m5p4t5 --------------------------
(* Car-wash conveyor line whose wash bay holds a bounded number of cars.  *)
(* Each admission is gated by a quorum vote of the bay controllers.       *)
(* Twist: a privileged admin can override the vote and force an admit --  *)
(* yet the bounded bay capacity must never be exceeded even so.           *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Ctrl == {1, 2, 3}
Cap == 2            \* bounded wash-bay capacity
Quorum == 2         \* controllers required to approve an admit

VARIABLES inBay, ballot, voting, adminOn

vars == <<inBay, ballot, voting, adminOn>>

Init ==
    /\ inBay = 0
    /\ ballot = [c \in Ctrl |-> "none"]
    /\ voting = FALSE
    /\ adminOn = FALSE

\* Open a fresh admission vote.
Propose ==
    /\ voting = FALSE
    /\ voting' = TRUE
    /\ ballot' = [c \in Ctrl |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inBay, adminOn>>

\* A controller records its vote.
CastBallot(c) ==
    /\ voting = TRUE
    /\ ballot[c] = "none"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![c] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inBay, voting, adminOn>>

\* With a quorum of approvals, admit one car (respecting capacity).
AdmitByQuorum ==
    /\ voting = TRUE
    /\ Cardinality({c \in Ctrl : ballot[c] = "yes"}) >= Quorum
    /\ inBay < Cap
    /\ inBay' = inBay + 1
    /\ voting' = FALSE
    /\ ballot' = [c \in Ctrl |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED adminOn

\* Admin override forces an admit without a quorum -- still capacity bound.
AdminAdmit ==
    /\ adminOn = TRUE
    /\ inBay < Cap
    /\ inBay' = inBay + 1
    /\ voting' = FALSE
    /\ ballot' = [c \in Ctrl |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED adminOn

\* A washed car leaves the bay.
Exit ==
    /\ inBay > 0
    /\ inBay' = inBay - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, voting, adminOn>>

\* Toggle the admin override privilege.
ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ adminOn' = ~adminOn
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inBay, ballot, voting>>

Next ==
    \/ Propose
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : CastBallot(c)
    \/ AdmitByQuorum
    \/ AdminAdmit
    \/ Exit
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded, even under admin override.
WithinCapacity == inBay <= Cap
=============================================================================
nl: A car-wash conveyor line has a wash bay of strictly bounded capacity, and every admission is gated by a quorum vote of three bay controllers. Propose opens a fresh admission vote, and each controller records a yes or no with CastBallot. AdmitByQuorum lets a car into the bay once a quorum of controllers has approved and only while the bay is below capacity. A privileged admin override, armed and disarmed by ToggleAdmin, enables AdminAdmit to force a car in without a quorum, but this override still refuses to admit when the bay is full. A washed car leaves through Exit. The full action set is Propose, CastBallot, AdmitByQuorum, AdminAdmit, Exit, and ToggleAdmin. SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of cars inside the wash bay never exceeds the bounded capacity, even under admin override.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m1p2t3 --------------------------
(* Container-ship crane yard laid out as a ring of berths. A circulating  *)
(* token grants the sole crane the right to lift a container off the      *)
(* current berth and set it down again. Containers are conserved.         *)
(* Twist: a berth may be slow (declining crane work) but never fails.     *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Berth == {1, 2, 3}
Boxes == 3          \* total conserved containers
CraneCap == 2

Succ(b) == (b % 3) + 1

VARIABLES tok, stack, crane, slow

vars == <<tok, stack, crane, slow>>

Init ==
    /\ tok = 1
    /\ stack = [b \in Berth |-> IF b = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0]
    /\ crane = 0
    /\ slow = [b \in Berth |-> FALSE]

\* Hand the token to the next berth in the ring.
Grant ==
    /\ tok' = Succ(tok)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, crane, slow>>

\* A non-slow token holder lifts one container onto the crane.
LoadCrane ==
    /\ slow[tok] = FALSE
    /\ stack[tok] > 0
    /\ crane < CraneCap
    /\ crane' = crane + 1
    /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![tok] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, slow>>

\* A non-slow token holder sets a container down at its berth.
UnloadCrane ==
    /\ slow[tok] = FALSE
    /\ crane > 0
    /\ crane' = crane - 1
    /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![tok] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, slow>>

\* A berth becomes slow (it will hold, not drop, its work).
MarkSlow(b) ==
    /\ slow[b] = FALSE
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, stack, crane>>

\* A slow berth resumes normal service.
Resume(b) ==
    /\ slow[b] = TRUE
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, stack, crane>>

Next ==
    \/ Grant
    \/ LoadCrane
    \/ UnloadCrane
    \/ \E b \in Berth : MarkSlow(b)
    \/ \E b \in Berth : Resume(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: containers on berths plus those on the crane stay constant.
Conserved == stack[1] + stack[2] + stack[3] + crane = Boxes
=============================================================================
nl: A container-ship crane yard is laid out as a ring of three berths served by one shared crane, whose right to work moves with a circulating token advanced by Grant. When the token holder is not slow it runs LoadCrane to lift a container off its stack onto the crane, or UnloadCrane to set a carried container back down at its berth. A berth may become slow via MarkSlow, in which case it holds its work and declines crane operations rather than dropping anything, and it can later Resume normal service; a slow berth never loses a container. Since loading and unloading only relocate containers, the total number in the yard is conserved. The full action set is Grant, LoadCrane, UnloadCrane, MarkSlow, and Resume. SAFETY PROPERTY: The containers stacked on the three berths plus those held by the crane always sum to the fixed total.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m3p2t2 --------------------------
(* Wildfire drone surveillance swarm. Two independent swarm instances     *)
(* each elect a lead drone and draw one flight credit from a shared pool. *)
(* On leader failure a failover releases the credit back to the pool.     *)
(* Twist: both instances draw from and return to one common credit pool.  *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Inst == {"A", "B"}
Drone == {1, 2, 3}
Credits == 3        \* total conserved flight credits

VARIABLES leader, alloc, pool, up

vars == <<leader, alloc, pool, up>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = [i \in Inst |-> 0]
    /\ alloc = [i \in Inst |-> 0]
    /\ pool = Credits
    /\ up = [d \in Drone |-> TRUE]

\* Elect an operational, unassigned drone to lead a vacant instance.
Elect(i, d) ==
    /\ leader[i] = 0
    /\ up[d] = TRUE
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ \A j \in Inst : leader[j] # d
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = d]
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED up

\* A drone fails; any instance it led vacates and returns its credit.
Fail(d) ==
    LET orphan == {i \in Inst : leader[i] = d} IN
    /\ up[d] = TRUE
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = [i \in Inst |-> IF leader[i] = d THEN 0 ELSE leader[i]]
    /\ alloc' = [i \in Inst |-> IF leader[i] = d THEN alloc[i] - 1 ELSE alloc[i]]
    /\ pool' = pool + Cardinality(orphan)

\* A failed drone returns to service.
Recover(d) ==
    /\ up[d] = FALSE
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alloc, pool>>

\* Reassign leadership to another live drone, keeping the held credit.
Handover(i, d) ==
    /\ leader[i] # 0
    /\ up[d] = TRUE
    /\ d # leader[i]
    /\ \A j \in Inst : leader[j] # d
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, pool, up>>

\* An instance stands down voluntarily, returning its credit.
Release(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # 0
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![i] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED up

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Inst, d \in Drone : Elect(i, d)
    \/ \E d \in Drone : Fail(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drone : Recover(d)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, d \in Drone : Handover(i, d)
    \/ \E i \in Inst : Release(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: allocated credits plus the free pool always total Credits.
Conserved == alloc["A"] + alloc["B"] + pool = Credits
=============================================================================
nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm runs two independent instances that share one common pool of flight credits. Each instance elects a lead drone with Elect, drawing one credit from the shared pool for the newly seated leader. When a drone Fails, any instance it was leading vacates its leadership and returns the held credit to the pool, modeling failover; a failed drone can later Recover and rejoin service. An instance may Handover leadership to another live drone while keeping its credit, or Release its leadership voluntarily and return the credit to the pool. Every credit is either allocated to an instance or resting in the shared pool, so credits are neither created nor destroyed. The full action set is Elect, Fail, Recover, Handover, and Release. SAFETY PROPERTY: The credits held by instance A and instance B together with the free pool always sum to the fixed total of credits.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m4p4t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker. Two independent matchmaker         *)
(* instances (A and B) share ONE pool of match slots.  Each instance runs  *)
(* a bounded intake queue with backpressure and admits queued players into *)
(* the shared pool.  Bounded pool capacity must never be exceeded even     *)
(* though the two instances act independently.                             *)

Cap  == 3      \* shared pool capacity
QMax == 2      \* per-instance intake queue bound (backpressure)

VARIABLES qa, qb, poolA, poolB

vars == << qa, qb, poolA, poolB >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ qa    \in Nat
    /\ qb    \in Nat
    /\ poolA \in Nat
    /\ poolB \in Nat

Init ==
    /\ qa    = 0
    /\ qb    = 0
    /\ poolA = 0
    /\ poolB = 0

\* Backpressure: an instance accepts a new player only while its queue is
\* below the intake bound.
EnqueueA ==
    /\ qa < QMax
    /\ qa' = qa + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qb, poolA, poolB >>

EnqueueB ==
    /\ qb < QMax
    /\ qb' = qb + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qa, poolA, poolB >>

\* Admission checks the shared occupancy against the shared capacity.
AdmitA ==
    /\ qa > 0
    /\ poolA + poolB < Cap
    /\ qa'    = qa - 1
    /\ poolA' = poolA + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qb, poolB >>

AdmitB ==
    /\ qb > 0
    /\ poolA + poolB < Cap
    /\ qb'    = qb - 1
    /\ poolB' = poolB + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qa, poolA >>

\* Players finishing a match leave the shared pool, freeing slots.
LeaveA ==
    /\ poolA > 0
    /\ poolA' = poolA - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qa, qb, poolB >>

LeaveB ==
    /\ poolB > 0
    /\ poolB' = poolB - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << qa, qb, poolA >>

Next ==
    \/ EnqueueA \/ EnqueueB
    \/ AdmitA   \/ AdmitB
    \/ LeaveA   \/ LeaveB

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Two independent instances share one pool; their combined occupancy must
\* never exceed the shared capacity bound.
CapacityRespected == poolA + poolB <= Cap

=============================================================================
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker is served by two independent matchmaker instances, A and B, that both feed players into a single shared pool of match slots with a fixed capacity. Each instance keeps its own bounded intake queue and applies backpressure: EnqueueA and EnqueueB accept a new waiting player only while that instance's queue is still below the intake bound. AdmitA and AdmitB take a queued player from an instance and place them into the shared pool, but only when the combined occupancy contributed by both instances is still below the shared capacity. LeaveA and LeaveB model players finishing their match and departing the pool, freeing shared slots for future admissions. Because the two instances admit players independently against the same shared capacity, the danger is that their concurrent admissions overshoot the limit.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The combined number of players placed in the shared pool by the two instances never exceeds the pool's capacity.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m3p1t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A stock exchange opening auction with a single shared record (the       *)
(* auction book) maintained by an elected leader.  Leaders can fail and a   *)
(* new leader is elected on a fresh term (failover).  Client update         *)
(* messages may be committed in any order (reordering).  An update that has *)
(* been acknowledged to the client must never be lost from the shared       *)
(* record.                                                                   *)

Nodes   == {1, 2, 3}
Updates == {1, 2, 3}
MaxTerm == 3

VARIABLES leader, term, ledger, pending, acked

vars == << leader, term, ledger, pending, acked >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader  \in Nodes \cup {0}
    /\ term    \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ ledger  \subseteq Updates
    /\ pending \subseteq Updates
    /\ acked   \subseteq Updates

Init ==
    /\ leader  = 0
    /\ term    = 0
    /\ ledger  = {}
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ acked   = {}

\* Failover: with no active leader, some node takes leadership, advancing
\* the term until the bound is reached.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = 0
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term'   = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED << ledger, pending, acked >>

\* The current leader crashes.
Crash ==
    /\ leader # 0
    /\ leader' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, ledger, pending, acked >>

\* A client submits an update; it joins the reorderable pending set.
Submit(u) ==
    /\ u \notin pending
    /\ u \notin ledger
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, ledger, acked >>

\* The leader durably commits any pending update (reordered commit).
Commit(u) ==
    /\ leader # 0
    /\ u \in pending
    /\ ledger'  = ledger \cup {u}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, acked >>

\* An update is acknowledged to the client only after it is durable.
Ack(u) ==
    /\ u \in ledger
    /\ u \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, ledger, pending >>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes   : Elect(n)
    \/ Crash
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Submit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Commit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Ack(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: every update acknowledged to a client is present in the
\* durable shared record.
NoLostUpdates == acked \subseteq ledger

=============================================================================
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction whose order book is a single shared record maintained by an elected leader node. Leadership can change through failover: Elect lets an idle node take over when there is no active leader, advancing the election term up to a bound, while Crash models the current leader failing and leaving the book leaderless. Clients place updates through Submit, which drops an update-id into a pending set that may later be processed in any order. The leader durably writes a pending update into the shared record with Commit, choosing any pending update regardless of arrival order to reflect that messages can be reordered. Ack acknowledges an update back to the submitting client, but only once that update is already durable in the record. The risk is that reordering and mid-auction leader failover could acknowledge an update that never actually made it into the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every update that has been acknowledged to a client is present in the durable shared auction record.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m8p2t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A library book-reservation system.  A fixed number of identical copies   *)
(* of a title move between four states: on the shelf, reserved, checked     *)
(* out, and in transit between branches.  Movements are guarded by          *)
(* hierarchical locks: a coarse branch lock must be taken before a fine     *)
(* per-title lock.  Transit and shelving messages may be processed in any   *)
(* order.  No copy is ever created or destroyed.                            *)

Branches == {1, 2, 3}
Total    == 3           \* total copies of the title; conserved

VARIABLES shelf, reserved, out, transit, coarse, fine

vars == << shelf, reserved, out, transit, coarse, fine >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelf    \in 0..Total
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ out      \in 0..Total
    /\ transit  \in 0..Total
    /\ coarse   \in Branches \cup {0}
    /\ fine     \in {0, 1}

Init ==
    /\ shelf    = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ out      = 0
    /\ transit  = 0
    /\ coarse   = 0
    /\ fine     = 0

\* Take the coarse branch lock (only when free).
LockBranch(b) ==
    /\ coarse = 0
    /\ coarse' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, reserved, out, transit, fine >>

\* Take the fine per-title lock, but only while holding a coarse lock.
LockTitle(b) ==
    /\ coarse = b
    /\ fine = 0
    /\ fine' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, reserved, out, transit, coarse >>

\* Reserve an available copy; requires both locks.
Reserve ==
    /\ fine = 1
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ shelf'    = shelf - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << out, transit, coarse, fine >>

\* Check out a reserved copy; requires both locks.
Checkout ==
    /\ fine = 1
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ out'      = out + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, transit, coarse, fine >>

\* A returned copy enters transit (reorderable delivery).
Return ==
    /\ out > 0
    /\ out'     = out - 1
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, reserved, coarse, fine >>

\* A transiting copy is reshelved and both locks are released.
Shelve ==
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ shelf'   = shelf + 1
    /\ coarse'  = 0
    /\ fine'    = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED << reserved, out >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Branches : LockBranch(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : LockTitle(b)
    \/ Reserve
    \/ Checkout
    \/ Return
    \/ Shelve

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: the total number of copies across all four states is
\* invariant -- nothing is ever created or destroyed.
Conserved == shelf + reserved + out + transit = Total

=============================================================================
nl:
A library book-reservation system tracks a fixed number of identical copies of a title as they move between four states: on the shelf, reserved for a patron, checked out, and in transit between branches. Movements are protected by hierarchical locks. LockBranch takes the coarse branch-level lock when it is free, and LockTitle takes the fine per-title lock but only while the corresponding coarse lock is already held, enforcing the coarse-then-fine ordering. Reserve moves an available copy from the shelf into the reserved state and Checkout moves a reserved copy into the checked-out state, both requiring the fine lock to be held. Return sends a checked-out copy into transit, and Shelve delivers a transiting copy back onto the shelf and releases both locks; because transit and shelving are handled asynchronously these deliveries may be processed in any order. Throughout all of this the physical copies are only ever moved, never minted or lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of copies summed across the shelf, reserved, checked-out, and in-transit states always equals the fixed total, so no copy is ever created or destroyed.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m2p0t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A warehouse robot fleet arbitrates access to one critical resource (a    *)
(* single narrow charging aisle) using two-phase commit.  A coordinator     *)
(* collects votes from all robots; only a unanimous yes with free capacity  *)
(* lets the requesting robot enter the critical section.  The aisle's       *)
(* capacity can change at runtime.  At most one robot may occupy the        *)
(* critical section at a time.                                              *)

Robots == {1, 2, 3}

VARIABLES phase, vote, requester, inCS, capacity

vars == << phase, vote, requester, inCS, capacity >>

NoVotes == [ r \in Robots |-> "none" ]

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase     \in {"idle", "collecting", "decided"}
    /\ vote      \in [Robots -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ requester \in Robots \cup {0}
    /\ inCS      \subseteq Robots
    /\ capacity  \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ phase     = "idle"
    /\ vote      = NoVotes
    /\ requester = 0
    /\ inCS      = {}
    /\ capacity  = 1

\* A robot opens a two-phase commit round to request the aisle.
Request(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ requester = 0
    /\ requester' = r
    /\ phase'     = "collecting"
    /\ vote'      = NoVotes
    /\ UNCHANGED << inCS, capacity >>

\* A participant casts its vote during collection.
CastVote(r, v) ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ vote[r] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, requester, inCS, capacity >>

\* Commit succeeds only on unanimous yes, with free capacity and an empty
\* critical section; the requester then enters.
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ \A r \in Robots : vote[r] = "yes"
    /\ capacity > 0
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS'  = {requester}
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, requester, capacity >>

\* Abort the round if any robot voted no or capacity is exhausted.
Abort ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ (\E r \in Robots : vote[r] = "no") \/ capacity = 0
    /\ phase'     = "idle"
    /\ requester' = 0
    /\ vote'      = NoVotes
    /\ UNCHANGED << inCS, capacity >>

\* The occupying robot leaves the critical section.
Release(r) ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ r \in inCS
    /\ inCS'      = inCS \ {r}
    /\ phase'     = "idle"
    /\ requester' = 0
    /\ vote'      = NoVotes
    /\ UNCHANGED << capacity >>

\* Capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
Rescale ==
    /\ capacity' \in 0..2
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, vote, requester, inCS >>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Request(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : \E v \in {"yes","no"} : CastVote(r, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Release(r)
    \/ Rescale

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: no two distinct robots ever share the critical section.
MutualExclusion == \A a, b \in inCS : a = b

=============================================================================
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates access to one critical resource, a single narrow charging aisle, using a two-phase commit protocol. Request opens a commit round when the coordinator is idle, recording which robot is asking and clearing the vote tally. CastVote lets each participating robot record a yes or no vote during the collection phase. Commit succeeds only when every robot has voted yes, the aisle still has free capacity, and the critical section is currently empty; the requesting robot then enters the aisle. Abort tears the round down and returns to idle whenever some robot voted no or capacity has dropped to zero. Release lets the occupying robot leave the aisle and frees the coordinator for the next round. Rescale models the aisle capacity being reconfigured at runtime to any allowed value. The hazard is that runtime capacity changes and concurrent commit rounds could admit a second robot while one is already inside.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one robot ever occupies the critical charging aisle at the same time.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m0p1t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Integers

(* A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps one shared, versioned record.  Two   *)
(* independent tracker instances share this single record and update it      *)
(* with optimistic concurrency: each reads the current version, stages a     *)
(* change, then commits only if the version is still unchanged (a            *)
(* compare-and-swap); otherwise it retries.  A stale write must never be     *)
(* allowed to slip through and silently lose another instance's update.      *)

Instances == {"a", "b"}
MaxVer    == 2

VARIABLES version, phase, readVer, commitVer

vars == << version, phase, readVer, commitVer >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version   \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ phase     \in [Instances -> {"idle","read","staged","done"}]
    /\ readVer   \in [Instances -> -1..MaxVer]
    /\ commitVer \in [Instances -> -1..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ version   = 0
    /\ phase     = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]
    /\ readVer   = [i \in Instances |-> -1]
    /\ commitVer = [i \in Instances |-> -1]

\* Read the current version of the shared record.
Read(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ phase'   = [phase   EXCEPT ![i] = "read"]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![i] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, commitVer >>

\* Stage the intended new inventory value locally.
Stage(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "read"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "staged"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, readVer, commitVer >>

\* Compare-and-swap commit: succeeds only if the version has not moved since
\* this instance read it.  It records the version it observed and bumps it.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "staged"
    /\ readVer[i] = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version'   = version + 1
    /\ commitVer' = [commitVer EXCEPT ![i] = version]
    /\ phase'     = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << readVer >>

\* CAS failed (version moved on) or the version bound was reached: retry from
\* scratch by returning to idle and discarding the stale read.
Retry(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "staged"
    /\ (readVer[i] # version \/ version = MaxVer)
    /\ phase'   = [phase   EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![i] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, commitVer >>

\* After a successful commit the instance frees up to do more work.
Recycle(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "done"
    /\ phase'   = [phase   EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![i] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, commitVer >>

\* Guarded terminal self-loop: everyone idle and the version bound reached.
Terminal ==
    /\ version = MaxVer
    /\ \A i \in Instances : phase[i] = "idle"

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Read(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Stage(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Retry(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Recycle(i)
    \/ (Terminal /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: any instance that has committed did so against exactly the
\* version it had read -- a stale commit (read version older than the version
\* it committed against) would silently overwrite an intervening update.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A i \in Instances : phase[i] = "done" => readVer[i] = commitVer[i]

=============================================================================
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps a single shared, versioned record that two independent tracker instances update concurrently using optimistic locking with retry. Read has an instance observe the current version of the shared record. Stage has it prepare its intended new inventory value locally. Commit performs the compare-and-swap: it succeeds only when the version the instance originally read still matches the current version, at which point it records the version it observed and increments the shared version. Retry fires when the compare-and-swap cannot succeed, either because another instance already advanced the version or because the version bound has been reached, sending the instance back to idle and discarding its stale read so it can try again. Recycle frees an instance that has just committed so it can begin more work, and a guarded terminal self-loop keeps the system live once every instance is idle and the version bound is reached. The danger is that a stale write could slip through and silently lose the other instance's update.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every instance that has committed did so against exactly the version it had read, so no stale write ever overwrites an intervening update.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Interbank settlement batch guarded by an expiring lease.
Bank == {1, 2}
Batch == {"clear"}
MaxT == 2
Dur == 2

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, inbox, committed, leases

vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, inbox, committed, leases>>

Message == [snd |-> 0, bat |-> "clear"]

LeaseFree == (holder = 0) \/ (clock >= expiry)

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ holder = 0
  /\ expiry = 0
  /\ inbox = {}
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ leases = {}

\* A bank grabs the settlement lease when the pool is free or the
\* previous lease has expired; the grant is journalled with its window.
Acquire(p) ==
  /\ LeaseFree
  /\ holder' = p
  /\ expiry' = clock + Dur
  /\ leases' = leases \cup {[who |-> p, start |-> clock, upto |-> clock + Dur]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inbox, committed>>

\* Wall-clock advances; leases can silently lapse as time passes.
Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxT
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, inbox, committed, leases>>

\* Any bank may drop a settlement request onto the shared bus. The bus
\* reorders and retains messages, so stale requests linger.
Submit(p, b) ==
  /\ [snd |-> p, bat |-> b] \notin inbox
  /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[snd |-> p, bat |-> b]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, committed, leases>>

\* The settlement engine applies a request only from the current lease
\* holder while its lease is still live.
Settle(m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ holder = m.snd
  /\ clock < expiry
  /\ \A c \in committed : c.bat # m.bat
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {[bat |-> m.bat, by |-> m.snd, ct |-> clock]}
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, leases>>

\* The bus may discard a reordered message.
Discard(m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, committed, leases>>

Done == clock = MaxT

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Bank : Acquire(p)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E p \in Bank, b \in Batch : Submit(p, b)
  \/ \E m \in inbox : Settle(m)
  \/ \E m \in inbox : Discard(m)
  \/ (Done /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every settled batch is backed by a lease that named the settling bank
\* and whose window covered the moment of settlement.
Authorized ==
  \A c \in committed :
    \E l \in leases :
      /\ l.who = c.by
      /\ l.start <= c.ct
      /\ c.ct < l.upto
====
nl:
A consortium of banks runs an interbank settlement batch over a shared message bus, and the right to post settlements is protected by a time-limited lease that expires on its own. The Acquire action lets a bank take the lease whenever the pool is free or the prior lease has already lapsed, journalling the grant together with the exact time window it covers. The Tick action advances the wall clock, which is what causes leases to silently expire. The Submit action lets any bank place a settlement request on the bus, which retains and reorders messages so that stale requests from former holders keep circulating. The Settle action applies a request to the ledger only when it came from the bank that currently holds the lease and only while that lease is still live, refusing to settle the same batch twice. The Discard action models the bus dropping a reordered message. Because messages can arrive out of order, an old request from a bank whose lease has since expired must never be posted.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every settled batch is backed by a journalled lease that named the settling bank and whose validity window covered the instant the settlement was recorded.

---- MODULE W4Od13m7p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* A fleet of vending controllers claims dispense slots through a
\* compare-and-swap owner register. A controller may be slow (its CAS
\* attempt lingers) but never crashes.
Ctrl == {1, 2, 3}
Slot == {"s1", "s2"}
NIL == 0
MaxSeq == 3

VARIABLES reg, attempts, allocLog, nextSeq, round

vars == <<reg, attempts, allocLog, nextSeq, round>>

Init ==
  /\ reg = [s \in Slot |-> NIL]
  /\ attempts = {}
  /\ allocLog = {}
  /\ nextSeq = 0
  /\ round = 0

\* A controller snapshots the current owner of a free slot and files a
\* CAS attempt carrying that expected value. Slowness means the attempt
\* may sit unresolved for a while.
Request(c, s) ==
  /\ reg[s] = NIL
  /\ ~\E a \in attempts : a.who = c /\ a.slot = s
  /\ attempts' = attempts \cup {[who |-> c, slot |-> s, exp |-> reg[s]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, allocLog, nextSeq, round>>

\* Time advances between snapshot and resolution, so a slow attempt can
\* become stale relative to the register.
Advance ==
  /\ round < 2
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, attempts, allocLog, nextSeq>>

\* CAS succeeds only when the register still equals the expected value;
\* it installs the new owner and journals the allocation.
Commit(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ reg[a.slot] = a.exp
  /\ nextSeq < MaxSeq
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![a.slot] = a.who]
  /\ allocLog' = allocLog \cup {[slot |-> a.slot, owner |-> a.who, seq |-> nextSeq]}
  /\ nextSeq' = nextSeq + 1
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED round

\* CAS fails when the register moved under a slow attempt; the attempt is
\* dropped and the controller would retry later.
Reject(a) ==
  /\ a \in attempts
  /\ reg[a.slot] # a.exp
  /\ attempts' = attempts \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, allocLog, nextSeq, round>>

Quiescent == attempts = {}

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl, s \in Slot : Request(c, s)
  \/ Advance
  \/ \E a \in attempts : Commit(a)
  \/ \E a \in attempts : Reject(a)
  \/ (Quiescent /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every journalled allocation agrees with the register's current owner
\* of that slot, so a slot is never handed to two different controllers.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A e \in allocLog : reg[e.slot] = e.owner
====
nl:
A network of vending controllers competes to own dispense slots, and ownership is arbitrated by a compare-and-swap register that maps each slot to its current owner. The Request action lets a controller snapshot the current owner of a free slot and file a CAS attempt that carries that expected value; a controller may be slow, so its attempt can sit unresolved for a while, but it never crashes. The Advance action moves time forward between the snapshot and its resolution, which is how a slow attempt becomes stale relative to the register. The Commit action performs the compare-and-swap: it succeeds only when the register still equals the expected value, at which point it installs the new owner and journals the allocation with a sequence number. The Reject action fires when the register has moved under a slow attempt, dropping the now-stale attempt so the controller would retry. Because two controllers can snapshot the same free slot, the CAS check is what guarantees only one of them wins.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every journalled allocation names the same owner that the register currently records for that slot, so no slot is ever allocated to two different controllers.

---- MODULE W4Od0m8p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Two independent operating-room scheduler instances share one pool of
\* rooms. Access uses hierarchical locks: a coarse pool lock must be held
\* before any fine per-room lock.
Inst == {"A", "B"}
Room == {"or1", "or2"}
NIL == "none"
MaxOps == 3

VARIABLES coarse, fine, booked, opSeq

vars == <<coarse, fine, booked, opSeq>>

Init ==
  /\ coarse = NIL
  /\ fine = [r \in Room |-> NIL]
  /\ booked = {}
  /\ opSeq = 0

\* An instance takes the coarse pool lock when nobody holds it.
GrabPool(i) ==
  /\ coarse = NIL
  /\ coarse' = i
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, booked, opSeq>>

\* An instance takes a fine room lock only while it already holds the
\* coarse pool lock -- the hierarchical ordering.
GrabRoom(i, r) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ fine[r] = NIL
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![r] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, booked, opSeq>>

\* A surgery is scheduled into a room only while the instance holds both
\* the coarse lock and that room's fine lock.
Schedule(i, r) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ fine[r] = i
  /\ opSeq < MaxOps
  /\ booked' = booked \cup {[room |-> r, by |-> i, seq |-> opSeq]}
  /\ opSeq' = opSeq + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

\* Locks are released in reverse order: fine first.
DropRoom(i, r) ==
  /\ fine[r] = i
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![r] = NIL]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, booked, opSeq>>

\* The coarse lock is released only once every fine room lock it covered
\* has been given up.
DropPool(i) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ \A r \in Room : fine[r] # i
  /\ coarse' = NIL
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, booked, opSeq>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Inst : GrabPool(i)
  \/ \E i \in Inst, r \in Room : GrabRoom(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Inst, r \in Room : Schedule(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Inst, r \in Room : DropRoom(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Inst : DropPool(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No fine room lock is ever held unless the same instance holds the
\* coarse pool lock -- no unauthorized fine acquisition can slip through.
HierarchyRespected ==
  \A r \in Room : fine[r] # NIL => coarse = fine[r]
====
nl:
Two independent operating-room scheduler instances share a single pool of rooms, and to avoid stepping on each other they use hierarchical locking: a coarse pool lock must be held before any fine per-room lock. The GrabPool action lets an instance take the coarse pool lock whenever nobody currently holds it. The GrabRoom action lets an instance take a fine room lock, but only while it already holds the coarse pool lock, which enforces the coarse-then-fine ordering. The Schedule action books a surgery into a room only while the acting instance holds both the coarse pool lock and that specific room's fine lock, recording the booking. The DropRoom action releases a fine room lock. The DropPool action releases the coarse pool lock, and it is allowed only once every fine room lock the instance held has been given up, so locks unwind in reverse order. Since two instances contend for the same pool, an instance must never end up holding a room lock without the covering pool lock.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No fine room lock is ever held unless the very same instance also holds the coarse pool lock.

---- MODULE W4Od1m8p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* An air-traffic runway allocator guards one shared assignment record
\* with hierarchical locks (sector lock, then record lock). Controllers
\* read-modify-write the record. Update messages can be reordered.
Ctrl == {1, 2}
Uid == {"u1", "u2"}
MaxVer == 2

VARIABLES sector, recLock, record, inbox, applied

vars == <<sector, recLock, record, inbox, applied>>

Init ==
  /\ sector = 0
  /\ recLock = 0
  /\ record = 0
  /\ inbox = {}
  /\ applied = {}

\* A controller reads the record and drafts an update stamped with the
\* version it observed. The message bus keeps and reorders drafts.
Propose(c, id) ==
  /\ ~\E m \in inbox : m.uid = id
  /\ ~\E a \in applied : a.uid = id
  /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[uid |-> id, by |-> c, base |-> record]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, recLock, record, applied>>

\* Take the coarse sector lock when it is free.
LockSector(c) ==
  /\ sector = 0
  /\ sector' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<recLock, record, inbox, applied>>

\* Take the fine record lock only while already holding the sector lock.
LockRecord(c) ==
  /\ sector = c
  /\ recLock = 0
  /\ recLock' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, record, inbox, applied>>

\* Commit a drafted update only under both locks and only when its read
\* version still matches the record -- the guard that stops lost updates
\* from stale, reordered drafts.
Apply(c, m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ sector = c
  /\ recLock = c
  /\ m.by = c
  /\ m.base = record
  /\ record < MaxVer
  /\ record' = record + 1
  /\ applied' = applied \cup {[uid |-> m.uid, by |-> m.by, base |-> m.base]}
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, recLock>>

\* Release both locks together.
Release(c) ==
  /\ sector = c
  /\ recLock' = 0
  /\ sector' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, inbox, applied>>

Done == inbox = {} /\ sector = 0 /\ recLock = 0

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl, id \in Uid : Propose(c, id)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl : LockSector(c)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl : LockRecord(c)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl, m \in inbox : Apply(c, m)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Release(c)
  \/ (Done /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every version the record passed through was the read-base of exactly
\* the update that produced its successor: the applied updates form an
\* unbroken chain with no overwritten (lost) update.
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A k \in 0..(record - 1) : \E a \in applied : a.base = k
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator serializes edits to a single shared assignment record using hierarchical locks: a coarse sector lock must be taken before the fine record lock. Controllers change the record by read-modify-write, and because the message bus can reorder update drafts, a draft based on an out-of-date read may resurface later. The Propose action lets a controller read the record and draft an update stamped with the version it just observed; the bus retains and reorders these drafts. The LockSector action takes the coarse sector lock while it is free. The LockRecord action takes the fine record lock, but only while the same controller already holds the sector lock. The Apply action commits a drafted update, and it fires only under both locks and only when the draft's read version still equals the record's current version, which is the guard that prevents a stale reordered draft from silently overwriting a newer value. The Release action drops both locks together. Without that version check a lost update could occur when two controllers read the same version.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every version the record passed through served as the read-base of exactly one committed update, so the applied updates form an unbroken chain with no overwritten update.

---- MODULE W4Od5m0p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* A multiplayer lobby matchmaker admits players to a shared lobby record
\* using optimistic locking with retry: a player reads a version, drafts a
\* claim against it, and the claim commits only if the version is
\* unchanged. One player may crash silently and simply stop acting.
Player == {1, 2}
MaxVer == 2

VARIABLES ver, view, crashed, pending, roster

vars == <<ver, view, crashed, pending, roster>>

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ view = [p \in Player |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ roster = {}

\* A live player refreshes its cached view to the lobby's current version.
Refresh(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![p] = ver]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, crashed, pending, roster>>

\* A live player drafts a claim stamped with the version it last saw.
Submit(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ ~\E c \in pending : c.who = p
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {[who |-> p, expect |-> view[p]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, view, crashed, roster>>

\* Optimistic commit: a claim admits its player only if the lobby version
\* still matches what the player expected and the player has not crashed;
\* the admission is stamped with the new version.
Commit(c) ==
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ c.expect = ver
  /\ c.who \notin crashed
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ roster' = roster \cup {[who |-> c.who, expect |-> c.expect, stamp |-> ver + 1]}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<view, crashed>>

\* A claim whose expected version is stale loses the race and is retried:
\* the draft is discarded so the player can refresh and resubmit.
Retry(c) ==
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ c.expect # ver
  /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, view, crashed, roster>>

\* A player crashes silently and takes no further action.
Crash(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, view, pending, roster>>

Halted == \A p \in Player : p \in crashed

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Player : Refresh(p)
  \/ \E p \in Player : Submit(p)
  \/ \E c \in pending : Commit(c)
  \/ \E c \in pending : Retry(c)
  \/ \E p \in Player : Crash(p)
  \/ (Halted /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every admission was granted against the version immediately preceding
\* the one it received, so no stale player's claim ever slipped through.
NoStaleAdmit ==
  \A a \in roster : a.expect = a.stamp - 1
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker admits players into a shared lobby record using optimistic locking with retry: a player reads the lobby's version, drafts a claim stamped with that version, and the claim is accepted only if the version has not moved in the meantime. One player is allowed to crash silently and simply stop participating. The Refresh action lets a live player update its cached view to the lobby's current version. The Submit action lets a live player draft a claim carrying the version it last saw. The Commit action performs the optimistic check: it admits the claim's player only when the lobby version still equals what that player expected and the player has not crashed, stamping the admission with the newly incremented version. The Retry action fires when a claim's expected version is stale, discarding the draft so the player can refresh and resubmit. The Crash action makes a player fail silently and take no further steps. Because several players may race on the same version, the optimistic check must reject any admission based on an out-of-date read.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every admission on the roster was granted against the version immediately preceding the one it was stamped with, so no stale claim ever slipped through.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m6p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Block == {1, 2, 3}
Train == {1, 2, 3}
NONE == 0
Capacity == 2
Lease == 2
MaxTime == 3

VARIABLES owner, deadline, clock, pinned

vars == <<owner, deadline, clock, pinned>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in [Block -> Train \cup {NONE}]
  /\ deadline \in [Block -> 0..(MaxTime + Lease)]
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
  /\ pinned \subseteq Block

Init ==
  /\ owner = [b \in Block |-> NONE]
  /\ deadline = [b \in Block |-> 0]
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ pinned = {}

Active == {b \in Block : owner[b] # NONE}

\* A train grabs a free block only while spare capacity remains.
Acquire(b, t) ==
  /\ owner[b] = NONE
  /\ Cardinality(Active) < Capacity
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = t]
  /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![b] = clock + Lease]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, pinned>>

\* An unpinned active lease may be extended before it expires.
Renew(b) ==
  /\ owner[b] # NONE
  /\ b \notin pinned
  /\ clock < deadline[b]
  /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![b] = clock + Lease]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, clock, pinned>>

\* A lapsed, unpinned lease is reclaimed, freeing the block.
Expire(b) ==
  /\ owner[b] # NONE
  /\ b \notin pinned
  /\ clock >= deadline[b]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
  /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, pinned>>

\* Admin override: pin an already-held block so timers never reclaim it.
AdminPin(b) ==
  /\ owner[b] # NONE
  /\ b \notin pinned
  /\ pinned' = pinned \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, deadline, clock>>

\* Admin override: force-grant a free block, still honoring capacity.
AdminGrant(b, t) ==
  /\ owner[b] = NONE
  /\ Cardinality(Active) < Capacity
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = t]
  /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![b] = MaxTime + Lease]
  /\ pinned' = pinned \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxTime
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, deadline, pinned>>

Done ==
  /\ clock = MaxTime
  /\ \A b \in Block : (owner[b] # NONE => (b \in pinned \/ clock < deadline[b]))

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Block, t \in Train : Acquire(b, t)
  \/ \E b \in Block : Renew(b)
  \/ \E b \in Block : Expire(b)
  \/ \E b \in Block : AdminPin(b)
  \/ \E b \in Block, t \in Train : AdminGrant(b, t)
  \/ Tick
  \/ (Done /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapBounded == Cardinality(Active) <= Capacity
====
nl: A subway signalling block system controls three track blocks that trains lease for exclusive movement authority. To preserve safe spacing the line enforces a shared capacity of at most two simultaneously leased blocks. A train may Acquire a free block only while spare capacity remains, taking a lease that expires after a fixed duration on the global clock. The holder may Renew an unpinned lease before it lapses, and once a lease is past its deadline the system may Expire it, releasing the block. A privileged dispatcher wields two admin overrides: AdminPin marks a held block so ordinary timers can never reclaim it, and AdminGrant force-assigns a free block with a long-lived pinned lease, but even the override still refuses to exceed the two-block capacity. A Tick advances the clock up to the horizon, after which a settled configuration self-loops. SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of blocks currently held under an active lease never exceeds the line's capacity of two.

---- MODULE W4Od2m9p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

Robot == {1, 2, 3}
NONE == 999
MaxVer == 3
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES ver, staged, log, epoch, crashed

vars == <<ver, staged, log, epoch, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ staged \in [Robot -> (0..MaxVer) \cup {NONE}]
  /\ log \in Seq(0..MaxVer)
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ crashed \subseteq Robot

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ staged = [r \in Robot |-> NONE]
  /\ log = << >>
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A live robot snapshots the record's current version as its write basis.
Snapshot(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![r] = ver]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, log, epoch, crashed>>

\* A commit succeeds only when the staged basis is still the current version.
Commit(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ staged[r] # NONE
  /\ staged[r] = ver
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ log' = Append(log, staged[r])
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed>>

\* A robot whose basis went stale abandons the staged write and must retry.
Abort(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ staged[r] # NONE
  /\ staged[r] # ver
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, log, epoch, crashed>>

\* An epoch-numbered reconfiguration invalidates every outstanding snapshot.
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ staged' = [r \in Robot |-> NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, log, crashed>>

\* A robot may crash silently, losing its staged work and going quiet forever.
Crash(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, log, epoch>>

Done == crashed = Robot

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Robot : Snapshot(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robot : Commit(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robot : Abort(r)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E r \in Robot : Crash(r)
  \/ (Done /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == \A k \in DOMAIN log : log[k] = k - 1
====
nl: A fleet of warehouse robots concurrently updates one shared inventory record that carries a monotonically increasing version number. A live robot performs Snapshot to read the record's current version as the basis for a pending write. It then performs Commit, which is accepted only when the staged basis still equals the current version; a successful commit advances the version by one and appends the basis it used to the commit log. If a robot's basis has gone stale it performs Abort and must retry with a fresh snapshot. The fleet controller may Reconfigure the deployment, bumping an epoch counter and invalidating every outstanding snapshot so robots re-read before writing. Any robot may Crash silently, dropping its staged work and falling permanently quiet; once all robots have crashed the system self-loops. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed write in the log was based on the version immediately preceding it, so no update ever silently overwrote a newer one.

---- MODULE W4Od1m0p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

Runway == {1, 2}
Flight == {1, 2, 3}
Authorized == {1, 2}
NONE == 0
MaxVer == 3

VARIABLES alloc, ver, snap, capacity, applied

vars == <<alloc, ver, snap, capacity, applied>>

Allocated == {rw \in Runway : alloc[rw] # NONE}

TypeOK ==
  /\ alloc \in [Runway -> Flight \cup {NONE}]
  /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ snap \in [Flight -> (0..MaxVer) \cup {NONE}]
  /\ capacity \in 1..Cardinality(Runway)
  /\ applied \in Seq([flight: Flight, basis: 0..MaxVer, atVer: 0..MaxVer])

Init ==
  /\ alloc = [rw \in Runway |-> NONE]
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ snap = [f \in Flight |-> NONE]
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ applied = << >>

\* Any flight may optimistically snapshot the table's current version.
Read(f) ==
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![f] = ver]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, ver, capacity, applied>>

\* Allocation commits only for an authorized flight whose read is still fresh.
Allocate(f, rw) ==
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ f \in Authorized
  /\ snap[f] = ver
  /\ alloc[rw] = NONE
  /\ Cardinality(Allocated) < capacity
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![rw] = f]
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ applied' = Append(applied, [flight |-> f, basis |-> snap[f], atVer |-> ver])
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity>>

\* A flight whose snapshot went stale must discard it and read again.
Retry(f) ==
  /\ snap[f] # NONE
  /\ snap[f] # ver
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, ver, capacity, applied>>

\* Releasing a runway bumps the version, invalidating outstanding snapshots.
Release(rw) ==
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ alloc[rw] # NONE
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![rw] = NONE]
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, capacity, applied>>

\* Runtime capacity change: the allocator resizes the usable pool live.
Resize ==
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ \E c \in 1..Cardinality(Runway) :
        /\ c # capacity
        /\ capacity' = c
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, snap, applied>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Flight : Read(f)
  \/ \E f \in Flight, rw \in Runway : Allocate(f, rw)
  \/ \E f \in Flight : Retry(f)
  \/ \E rw \in Runway : Release(rw)
  \/ Resize

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthFresh ==
  \A k \in DOMAIN applied :
    /\ applied[k].flight \in Authorized
    /\ applied[k].basis = applied[k].atVer
====
nl: An air-traffic runway allocator hands exclusive runway slots to inbound flights through an optimistic-locking protocol over a versioned allocation table. Any flight performs Read to snapshot the table's current version. A flight then performs Allocate, which commits a runway only when the flight is on the authorized clearance list, its snapshot still matches the live version, the runway is free, and the live count of occupied runways is below the current capacity; the commit records the flight, its read basis, and the version at commit into an audit log. A flight whose snapshot has been overtaken performs Retry, dropping the stale snapshot so it must read again. A controller performs Release to vacate an occupied runway, and Resize to change the usable capacity at runtime; both bump the version and thereby invalidate outstanding snapshots. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every allocation in the audit log was committed by an authorized flight whose read was fresh, so its recorded basis equals the table version at the moment of commit.

---- MODULE W4Od8m7p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Student == {1, 2, 3, 4}
Instance == {1, 2}
NONE == 0
Capacity == 3

VARIABLES enrolled, reg, rd, target

vars == <<enrolled, reg, rd, target>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ enrolled \subseteq Student
  /\ reg \in 0..(Capacity + 2)
  /\ rd \in [Instance -> (0..(Capacity + 2)) \cup {NONE}]
  /\ target \in [Instance -> Student \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ enrolled = {}
  /\ reg = 0
  /\ rd = [i \in Instance |-> NONE]
  /\ target = [i \in Instance |-> NONE]

\* An instance reads the shared seat register and stages a student to enroll.
ReadReg(i, s) ==
  /\ rd[i] = NONE
  /\ s \notin enrolled
  /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![i] = reg]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, reg>>

\* Compare-and-swap: commit only if the register still equals the read value.
CasCommit(i) ==
  /\ rd[i] # NONE
  /\ reg = rd[i]
  /\ rd[i] < Capacity
  /\ target[i] \notin enrolled
  /\ reg' = rd[i] + 1
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {target[i]}
  /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]

\* CAS fails when a racing instance has moved the register; the attempt retries.
CasFail(i) ==
  /\ rd[i] # NONE
  /\ reg # rd[i]
  /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, reg>>

\* A student drops the course, atomically freeing a seat in the shared pool.
Drop(s) ==
  /\ s \in enrolled
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {s}
  /\ reg' = reg - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rd, target>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instance, s \in Student : ReadReg(i, s)
  \/ \E i \in Instance : CasCommit(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instance : CasFail(i)
  \/ \E s \in Student : Drop(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapNeverExceeded == Cardinality(enrolled) <= Capacity
====
nl: A university course-registration system runs two independent registration instances that share one seat pool tracked by a single compare-and-swap register holding the enrolled count. An instance performs ReadReg to snapshot the register and stage a not-yet-enrolled student. It then performs CasCommit, which is a genuine compare-and-swap: it seats the staged student and writes the read value plus one back to the register only if the register still equals the value the instance read and that value is below the course capacity. If a racing instance has advanced the register in the meantime, CasFail fires and the attempt is abandoned for a later retry. A seated student may Drop the course, which atomically frees a seat by removing the student and decrementing the shared register. SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of students holding a seat never exceeds the course capacity, even though two instances contend on the shared register.

---- MODULE W4Od10m1p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Node == {1, 2, 3}

succ == [n \in Node |-> IF n = 3 THEN 1 ELSE n + 1]

VARIABLES record, committed, tokenA, tokenB, view

vars == <<record, committed, tokenA, tokenB, view>>

HoldsToken(n) == (n = tokenA) \/ (n = tokenB)

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \subseteq Node
  /\ committed \subseteq Node
  /\ tokenA \in Node
  /\ tokenB \in Node
  /\ view \in [Node -> SUBSET Node]

Init ==
  /\ record = {}
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ tokenA = 1
  /\ tokenB = 2
  /\ view = [n \in Node |-> {}]

\* Any node may freely snapshot the shared record pool for a later write.
Snapshot(n) ==
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = record]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, tokenA, tokenB>>

\* A token holder writes back its snapshot plus its own mark, but only while
\* that snapshot is still current -- the guard that stops a lost update.
Commit(n) ==
  /\ HoldsToken(n)
  /\ view[n] = record
  /\ record' = view[n] \cup {n}
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, view>>

\* Instance A rotates its token one step around the shared ring.
PassTokenA ==
  /\ tokenA' = succ[tokenA]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, tokenB, view>>

\* Instance B rotates its independent token one step around the same ring.
PassTokenB ==
  /\ tokenB' = succ[tokenB]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, tokenA, view>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Node : Snapshot(n)
  \/ \E n \in Node : Commit(n)
  \/ PassTokenA
  \/ PassTokenB

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == committed \subseteq record
====
nl: A subway signalling block system keeps one shared occupancy record that two independent control instances update over a common token ring; instance A and instance B each circulate their own token around the three ring nodes and may write only while holding a token. Any node performs Snapshot to read the shared record into its private view at any time. A token holder performs Commit, writing its snapshot extended with its own mark back to the shared record and recording that its update is committed, but only when its snapshot still matches the live record so that no concurrently written mark is clobbered. Instance A performs PassTokenA and instance B performs PassTokenB to rotate their respective tokens one step around the ring, handing write authority to the next node. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every node whose update has been committed still appears in the shared record, so no committed update is ever silently lost by a stale overwrite.
